Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. How much does it cost to rent a Nissan Patrol in Dubai?

Daily rentals start from AED 650, while monthly packages go up to AED 11,000 depending on duration and model.

Q2. Can I take the Nissan Patrol for a desert safari?

Yes! The Nissan Patrol is one of the best SUVs for desert driving, thanks to its power and 4×4 capabilities.

Q3. Is insurance included in the rental?

Yes. All IZI Rent Nissan Patrol rentals come with comprehensive insurance and 24/7 roadside assistance.

Q4. What documents are required to rent a Nissan Patrol?

You’ll need a valid driving license, passport or Emirates ID, and a credit card for the security deposit.

Q5. Does IZI Rent offer delivery and pickup?

Absolutely — we offer free delivery and pickup anywhere in Dubai, including the airport.
